_comment: Manual CRS-to-stop_group mapping for the Lancashire demo corridor. This file acts as a reliable fallback when the NaPTAN loader has not yet populated the crs_stop_group_map database table. Each key is a 3-letter National Rail CRS code (uppercase). Values: stop_group_id = NPTG locality code, representative_stop_id = the RAIL:{CRS} stop row used by the planner, station_name = human-readable label for logging / debugging. To add a new station, copy one block and fill in the three fields.
